summary: Iteration 39: frontend-only test of the responsive web tiers (preview host, live backend, mock signing adapter). All 7 requested flows pass for the core layout. (1) 700x900 phone tier: 'web-app-shell' is 480px wide at x=110 (centred), the backdrop shows on both sides, the 5 bottom tabs sit inside the column, and there is no horizontal overflow. (2) 900x1000 tablet tier: the shell is 820px at x=40. 'dashboard-tablet-grid' shows the 'Add a site' CTA next to Quick actions; My Documents and the query pill span the full width. There is no sidebar and the bottom tabs show. /documents shows cards in 2 columns. 'concierge-sheet' is a centred 600px dialog and 'concierge-sheet-close' closes it. The meter-install and business-switcher pop-ups are also centred dialogs at 900px. (3) Tablet review of sr_loa_01: the page is 520px inside the 820 column. 'next-field' opens the signature pad (320x180 canvas). A mouse stroke, then Apply, gives 4/4 fields, and the declaration enables submit. On sr_sc_01, ack, initials, sign1 and sign2 complete strictly in order (1/5 to 5/5). Tapping a field out of order shows 'lock-hint'. (4) 700px review: the page is 448px with no overflow. (5) 1440x900: desktop-sidebar and desktop-topbar render, there is no web-app-shell, the quotes-table rows render and the sites desktop view renders. (6) 390x844: the shell is 390px, there is no tablet grid, and all 5 tabs navigate. (7) /splash at 700px: each slide is 480px and Next moves exactly 480px. Boundaries: 767px = phone, 768-1023px = tablet, 1024px = desktop. MAIN BUG: on the web phone tier (480-767px), the concierge sheet, meter-install modal and business-switcher sheet ignore the 480 column and stretch to the full viewport width. Sheets built on useDesktopSheet (add-business) are capped correctly. No deprecated Expo packages were found.

ui_bugs.issue: Web phone tier (700px): the sheet renders at full viewport width (x=0, w=700), outside the 480 shell. The mobile branch uses <Portal> + styles.sheet with no width cap. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/have-a-query-pill.tsx:108-117
Web phone tier (700px): the sheet spans the full 700px instead of the 480 column (the kav is width 100% in a root Portal). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/meter-install-modal.tsx:220,361
Web phone tier (700px): the 'Switch business' sheet spans the full viewport. The mobile branch of renderSheet has no phone cap. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/business-switcher-chip.tsx:96
Likely the same issue in request-change-modal.tsx and app/documents/[id]/status.tsx (they use Portal with no phone cap).

Phone/tablet web: zooming in makes the page wider than the column (700px viewport: 558px page at x=71). The vertical-only ScrollView with alignItems:center clips both edges, so they can't be reached. This existed before but is more visible now. Reference: app/documents/[id]/review.tsx:395

issues: The 'next-field' touch target is 120x16 and needs at least 44 height or a hitSlop.
At 448px the date field text is cut off ('Filled automatically o...'), and the 'Fill now' badge on the small checkbox field wraps onto 2 lines (sr_sc_01, page 1).
The shell has 1px left/right borders, so the real inner width is 478/818. useFrameWidth returns 480/820, so splash slides and other frame-width layouts are 2px too wide (clipped).
The Quick actions cards (100px tall) are shorter than the CTA card (150px), which leaves empty space below them.
The type cards use width:'48%', so the right column ends about 10px short of the full-width inputs.

action_items: HIGH: On web phone tier, cap these bottom sheets to the 480 column: have-a-query-pill.tsx, meter-install-modal.tsx and business-switcher-chip.tsx. Check request-change-modal.tsx and documents/[id]/status.tsx too. Use the useDesktopSheet() phone styles (backdrop alignItems:center; sheet width 100%, maxWidth 480, alignSelf center). Leave native untouched. Another option: render the Portal host inside web-app-shell.
LOW: Fix zoom clipping on phone/tablet web. Use horizontal scroll or flex-start alignment when pageW is wider than the column.
LOW: Make the next-field hit area at least 44px tall.
LOW: Subtract the 1px shell borders in useFrameWidth.
critical_code_review_comments: Portal content mounts outside 'web-app-shell', so any Portal-based sheet skips the phone-tier cap unless it applies useDesktopSheet styles.
desktop/sheet.ts phoneKav has alignSelf center + maxWidth but no width:'100%'. Add it so the KAV can't shrink to its content.
Native is preserved: DesktopFrame passes children through on non-web, and useFrameWidth returns the full window.

success_rate.frontend: 88% (all 7 requested flows pass; 3 sheets not capped at phone tier)
